limitations: One cold session, not four independent samples per checkpoint.
PNG agreement is not independent semantic identity proof; operator must verify references.
Archive/theme/font are operator attestations; installed APK identity is checked.
PSS is context-dependent, not retained heap; no forced GC.
Compare separate ours/official sessions externally for excess growth.

ours.mask: All pixels outside the profiler comparison crop replaced with white; status/notification/navigation regions removed.

official.mask: All pixels outside the profiler comparison crop replaced with white; status/notification/navigation regions removed.

observedPresentation.mapTheme: Auto verified/restored before matched horizontal sessions. Archived mode enum is auto/light/dark.
observedPresentation.viewport: App-specific native and web-shell geometry; not identical renderers or tile counts.
observedPresentation.scaleUnits: Metric visible in ours; imperial observed in official during preparation. Scale units were not normalized or rechecked at every checkpoint.

interpretation: Ours has lower absolute endpoint total PSS in both pairs. This does not prove an optimization gain or consistent lower own-zero growth.
Checkpoint 20 excess growth reverses sign between pairs: approximately -19.41 MiB and +15.11 MiB. Shared mapped-code PSS changes materially; do not infer consistent retained-heap savings.

From checkpoint 5 to 20, ours changes by -18.36 and +0.55 MiB, and official by +2.45 and -0.56 MiB, in the respective pairs. No large continuing late rise is observed over this bounded workload; this does not prove against all leaks or unlimited growth.
All included sessions completed 20 cycles, 16 samples, cleanup, unchanged APK identities and stable process generations across checkpoints. Sessions, not nearby samples, are replication units.

First pair uses the reviewed private controller; second uses the published controller and exterior-masked PNGs with identical compared pixels. Accounting and action dispatch are unchanged; exact tool/input identities remain per session.
Endpoints verify return to the prepared Home map. Intermediate tile readiness,20distinct regions,vertical/native chrome behavior,search speed and battery use are not certified.
